note: Nominal colour anchors; textured artwork contains tonal variation. These are reusable authoring tokens, not a runtime dependency of the existing prototype.

structure.role: Ultramarine company and major structural subjects

ink.role: Figure clothing, drawn marks and primary UI text

money.role: Orange fictional cash and payment subjects

paper.role: Ivory paper accents and character highlights

typography.rule: Readable code-rendered labels; illustration carries the visual personality. Do not generate dynamic text in images.

material.surface: Tactile dyed paper, irregular fibrous grain, creases and scuffed ink
material.edge: Angular hand-cut silhouettes with controlled unevenness
material.depth: Shallow paper overlaps and restrained contact shadows
material.marks: Sparse angular facial marks; expressive silhouette before interior detail

composition.priority: One dominant illustrated relationship with space for actions and connected effects
composition.controls: Quiet controls adjacent to or below the scene; visible keyboard focus
composition.responsive: Recompose while preserving relationships and readable labels; avoid shrinking a desktop dashboard

motion.intent: User-triggered movement explains cause, ownership or time; preserve the final state
motion.reduced_motion: Apply the same final state immediately with a concise textual account
motion.timing_note: Prototype timings are references, not a prescribed duration for every lesson.
